incident.description: TEST / DEMO exploit report for the PlutusShield policy-cover v2 committee drill on Midnight Preprod. No funds were lost and no contract was exploited. This bundle exercises registerPolicy -> proveCover -> fileClaim -> three independent off-ledger assessor checks -> voteClaim from seat 0 (approve), seat 1 (reject: claim stays pending under 2-of-3) and seat 2 (approve: second approval marks the claim PAID). The tx hash listed is the policy's own Buy tx, used as a placeholder reference. Incident timestamps are drill placeholders, not a real event time.
